correctness.rationale: Composition of affine maps gives commuting condition (a-1)e=(c-1)b, so centralizer kernel of R^2->R has cardinality s^2/|(a-1,b)| for every finite commutative unital ring. For chain ring valuations, min valuations yield geometric multiplicities and commuting probability q^-k(1+q^-1-q^-k-1). For radical-square-zero local rings, pairs in maximal ideal span F_q-vector spaces of ranks 0,1,2, yielding four spectrum rows and exact cp; q^3 ring comparison difference (q-1)^2(q+1)/q^7. Independent exact enumerator normalization checked q=2,3,4,5,7, k=1..4 and d=2..4; arbitrary ring proof is algebraic, not test-based.
